text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up for last night's token-validation spike. Root cause: stale KMS key cached in auth service; rotation didn't invalidate microservice caches. Action list below.
ashok: Can you paste the specific steps to reproduce? we need to ensure tests cover this.
maria: Repro: rotate key in KMS -> auth service continues validating old tokens due to local cached signing key. Logs: `auth.signer: key_id=key-2026-03-22 stale_cache`.
ken: Ack. I'll add a unit/integration test in auth-service CI to fail on cache sticking longer than 1m.
emma: Who owns the rotation playbook update? I can take doc edits.
maria: @emma assigned for playbook. @ken assigned for CI tests. @ashok please own canary rollout gating and alerting.
ashok: on it. I'll add an automated check: post-rotation, make sample signed tokens and validate from each region. If mismatch -> rollback.
nick: we should also add an audit log entry for rotation events so we can trace which services saw new key. I'll add a logshipper tag.
ken: small PR: add env var `SIGNER_CACHE_TTL_MS=60000` with override for rollout. I'll target a canary to prod-dedicated-1.
emma: playbook edits planned by EOD Fri. Add a section: post-rotation verification checklist + who to call.
maria: timeline proposal: tests/PR by Wed, playbook by Fri, canary rollout Thu next week, org-wide rotation next month.
ashok: suggest adding recurring dev-sre runbook check monthly. Patterns show repeats when rotations are manual.
sre-bot: Note created: INCIDENT-1769998123, reminders set for assignees.
maria: Thanks. Nick, can you also ensure audit logs are retained 90d for rotations? We need trail for compliance.
nick: yes, filing ticket.
ken: quick question — do we want to expire old tokens immediately on rotation or support dual signing window? Could affect active sessions.
emma: Add dual-signing window (48h) to playbook, with explicit verification steps to handle token revocation.
ashok: We'll build fallback: if key mismatch, try previous key for 48h, but emit high-severity alert so teams can react.
maria: OK final call: owners: playbook=emma, CI/tests=ken, gating=ashok, audit retention=nick. Due dates above. I'll follow up in next standup.
ashok: +1
ken: LGTM :thumbsup:
emma: working on it :spiral_calendar:
nick: ticket created -> INFRA-4579
maria: Closing here; will update the postmortem doc with owners and timeline. Thanks all.
